title: Chapter 481 - 481 Apologies; Punishment

Chapter 481 - 481 Apologies; Punishment

Chapter 481 - 481 Apologies; Punishment

481 Apologies; Punishment

When Qin Changcun heard this, he could not help but reveal a smug smile.

‘Did you see that?

‘I know the chairman of the Whitehorse Manor!’

Then, he sneered at Lin Fan.

It was as if he was saying, ‘Kid, weren’t you very arrogant just now? I’ll see how arrogant you are later!’

“Mr. Grians, you have to manage the Whitehorse Manor well.” Qin Changcun cleared his throat and said. “I just offered a million yuan out of goodwill to discuss with this young man about subcontracting the luxury island to me.

“In the end, this young man actually insulted me.

“I don’t think such an uncultured young man is suitable to stay in the Whitehorse Manor. Perhaps he has even maliciously destroyed some of the facilities in the Whitehorse Manor…”

It had to be said that Qin Changcun was quite capable.

With just a few words, he had turned himself into an honest person who had been bullied and humiliated. He had painted Lin Fan as a rude and overbearing evil person.

At the same time, he also found a good reason for the Whitehorse Manor to chase Lin Fan away. He suspected that Lin Fan had destroyed the facilities of the Whitehorse Manor.

In addition, he had a personal relationship with Grians.

He had reason to believe that Lin Fan would be chased out of the Whitehorse Manor soon.

Grians frowned slightly and looked in the direction Qin Changcun pointed.

In the next moment…

Grians’ pupils constricted, and his expression changed drastically.

He realized that the person Qin Changcun was referring to was Lin Fan!

His own boss!

Qin Changcun said that his boss was unreasonable?

He even wanted to chase away the boss?!

What a bastard!

Qin Changcun did not notice the change in Grians’ expression.

“Mr. Grians, don’t worry. After he leaves, I’ll still spend one million yuan to book the luxury island. I…”

However, before he could finish, Grians shouted angrily, “Shut up!

“Now, immediately apologize to Mr. Lin. Otherwise, the Whitehorse Manor will not provide you with any services! We won’t even send you back to the seaside pier!”

Qin Changcun was stunned by the sudden change in Grians.

After a while, he stuttered, “Mr. Grians, Yuan Ping’an and I are friends… Moreover, you’re a seven-star hotel. You need to provide the appropriate service to your guests…”

At this moment, he had already realized that something was wrong.

Therefore, he no longer stuck to his previous method.

At the same time, he also explained what those in the hotel line should do.

“Apologize immediately!” Grians shouted angrily. “Otherwise, go swim in the sea! The planes and islands here are all our private property!”

Qin Changcun was only Yuan Ping’an’s friend.

Even if it was Yuan Ping’an himself, so what?

One had to know…

Yuan Ping’an was just a food supplier of the Whitehorse Manor.

In a sense, the Whitehorse Manor was Yuan Ping’an’s sugar daddy!

Yuan Ping’an was the one who had to please the Whitehorse Manor.

As for what Qin Changcun said about the Whitehorse Manor providing appropriate services to its guests, that was also right.

However, that was only under normal circumstances.

This was clearly not normal circumstances.

That was because the man had a conflict with Lin Fan.

He even wanted to chase Lin Fan out of the Whitehorse Manor.

This was absolutely unforgivable!

Grians knew that if he did not handle this matter well, Lin Fan’s impression of him would plummet to the bottom!

…

The pilot slowly stood up after hearing Grians’ words.

That appearance…

It was as if he would throw Qin Changcun and the woman into the sea if Grians said anything else.

Qin Changcun’s and the oval-faced woman’s hearts trembled, and their faces turned pale.

Qin Changcun knew that Grians was not joking. That young man probably had a terrifying identity.

He could only stutter, “M-Mr. Lin, I’m sorry. It’s my fault…”

Lin Fan said calmly, “Next time, don’t look down on others. Otherwise, just an apology won’t solve it.”

After saying that, he turned around and walked inside.

“Yes, yes, yes,” Qin Changcun hurriedly replied.

Grians said to the pilot of the seaplane, “Send them back.”

“Yes,” the pilot responded.

About 40 minutes later, Qin Changcun and the oval-faced woman returned to the seaside pier.

The oval-faced woman said, “Honey, who exactly is that Mr. Lin? How despicable!”

“Hmph!” Qin Changcun puffed out his chest and said. “If it was anywhere else, I would have made him pay!”

The oval-faced woman said, “Wow! Hubby, you’re so awesome!”

“Of course,” Qin Changcun said proudly.

The oval-faced woman added, “Why don’t we go to Vela’s private island? It’s also very fun there.”

“Alright.” Qin Changcun nodded.

Therefore, the oval-faced woman took out her phone and quickly searched for information about Vela’s private island.

At this moment, Qin Changcun’s phone rang.

He looked at the caller ID and saw that it was Yuan Ping’an.

Qin Changcun immediately answered the call.

“President Yuan, you…”

However, just as Qin Changcun opened his mouth, Yuan Ping’an’s roar sounded from inside.

“F*ck you, damn it!”

“I was kind enough to introduce you to Big Boss whenever I had the chance. I even brought you so much business. Is this how you repay me? Hmm?

“Now, the Whitehorse Manor has canceled all cooperation with me. In addition, Mr. Grians has also blacklisted me in the industry!

“I’m completely finished!

“I’m done for, and you won’t be able to live well either! Let me tell you, not only will I not cooperate with you in the future, but I will also make sure that all the business I introduced to you will end here.

“In addition, I also know about your illegal coal mining in the country and your tax evasion… Prepare to receive a report letter!”

After saying this, Yuan Ping’an hung up the phone.

Qin Changcun held the phone, his face pale.

Losing the business introduced by Yuan Ping’an, losing the coal mining, and possibly being wanted…

It was over!

He was completely finished!

The oval-faced woman next to him was completely unaware. She smiled and said, “Hubby, let’s go for the best and most expensive villa on Vela’s private island later…”

When Qin Changcun heard this voice, his heart was suddenly filled with anger.

It was her!

If it was not for this woman who insisted on coming to the Maldives and staying on the luxury island, how could he have offended Mr. Lin?

The more Qin Changcun thought about it, the angrier he became.

He raised his hand and slapped the oval-faced woman.

“B*tch!”
